app.name: PDFTools
app.description: A free, offline, private PDF editor for engineers.

ribbon.label: Ribbon
ribbon.needsDocument: Open a document to use this command

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This part of PDFTools stopped working. Your open files are not changed. Reload it to continue.

section.open: Open a PDF from your computer. Files never leave this device.
section.recent: Files you opened recently on this device.
section.save: Save changes to the original file (incremental save).
section.saveAs: Save a copy of the document to a new location.
section.saveOptimized: Rewrite the file compactly. Digital signatures would be invalidated.
section.settings: Settings and the data PDFTools keeps on this device.
section.about: About PDFTools: version and third-party notices.
section.privacy: PDFTools works offline. Your documents are never uploaded.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts for the commands available now. Alternates are listed for keys the browser keeps for itself.
shortcuts.reservedNote: The first key is used by the browser in a normal tab; use the alternate there.

error.notPdf: This file is not a PDF.
error.damaged: This PDF is damaged and can't be opened.
error.needsPassword: This PDF needs a password to open.
error.unreadable: The file could not be read. It may have been moved, deleted or changed.
error.tooMany: Too many documents are open. Close one and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong while opening this file.

open.dropHint: Drop PDF files to open them

close.title: Save changes to {{name}}?
close.description: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.

start.title: No document open
start.hint: Open a PDF or drop files here.

recent.title: Recent files
recent.denied: Permission to open {{name}} was not granted.
recent.missing: {{name}} is no longer available. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted.

error.title: Couldn't save {{name}}
error.permissionDenied: PDFTools doesn't have permission to change this file. Save a copy with Save As instead.
error.missing: The file can't be found. It may have been moved or deleted. Save a copy with Save As instead.
error.fileChanged: The file was changed by another program since it was opened, so it wasn't overwritten. Save a copy with Save As instead.
error.verifyFailed: The saved file could not be checked, so nothing was written. Your changes are still open.
error.needsRewrite: This file's structure is damaged, so changes can't be appended to it. Use Save Optimized to write a repaired copy.
error.writeFailed: The file could not be written. Your changes are still open. Save a copy with Save As instead.

optimize.title: Save {{name}} optimized
optimize.description: Rewrites the whole file compactly. You can save it as a new file or replace the original.
optimize.signatures_one: This file has {{count}} digital signature. Saving it optimized will invalidate it. Continue?
optimize.signatures_other: This file has {{count}} digital signatures. Saving it optimized will invalidate them. Continue?

growth.title: Save optimized instead?
growth.description: {{name}} has grown by more than 30 % since it was opened. Saving it optimized rewrites it compactly.

recovery.title: Recover unsaved changes?
recovery.description: PDFTools closed while these documents had unsaved changes. Recover them to continue where you left off, or discard the changes.

offline.waitDescription: The update restarts PDFTools, so it waits until every document is closed. It applies as soon as you close the last one, or the next time you start PDFTools.

check.found: An update is ready. It applies when you choose Update ready.
check.failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
check.unavailable: Updates aren't available in this browser.

localData.title: Data on this device
localData.note: Your PDF files stay where they are. PDFTools keeps only settings, the recent files list and recovery snapshots of unsaved changes. Storage used includes the offline copy of the app.
localData.confirmDescription: This deletes your settings, the recent files list and all recovery snapshots on this device. Your PDF files are not changed. The offline copy of the app is kept, so PDFTools keeps working offline.
localData.warnOpen_one: {{count}} document is open. It stays open.
localData.warnOpen_other: {{count}} documents are open. They stay open.
localData.warnUnsaved_one: {{count}} open document has unsaved changes. Its recovery snapshot is deleted too, so those changes could not be recovered after a crash until you change the document again.
localData.warnUnsaved_other: {{count}} open documents have unsaved changes. Their recovery snapshots are deleted too, so those changes could not be recovered after a crash until you change the documents again.
localData.failed: Some local data could not be cleared. Try again, or clear this site's data in your browser settings.

about.license: PDFTools is free software under the MIT License. It includes open-source components under their own permissive licenses.
about.notices: Third-party notices (opens in a new tab)

promise.documents: Your documents never leave this device. PDFTools opens, renders and saves them in your browser.
promise.account: No account, no login and no cookies.
promise.telemetry: No analytics scripts, no tracking and no telemetry.
promise.network: The only network requests PDFTools makes are checks for app updates on its own website.

data.caption: Data PDFTools keeps on this device
data.no: No (delete it with your browser's site data)
data.recent: Recent files: file name, size, when it was opened and the browser's permission handle to reopen it
data.recovery: Recovery snapshots: a copy of a document with unsaved changes, deleted when you save, close or discard it
data.appFiles: The offline copy of the app (program files only, no documents)

privacy.clearHint: To delete this data, use File → Settings → Clear all local data.

protect.restricted: Not allowed by this document's security settings
protect.notRestricted: This document has no restrictions to unlock

password.title: Password required
password.description: “{{name}}” is protected. Enter its password to open it.
password.label: Password
password.incorrect: That password is not correct. Try again.

unlockDialog.title: Unlock with owner password
unlockDialog.description: The owner password of “{{name}}” lifts its restrictions until you close it.
unlockDialog.label: Owner password
unlockDialog.incorrect: That owner password is not correct.
